_readme: Copy to config.local.json and fill in. NO secrets here: keys live in n8n credentials and secrets.local.json.
GHL_CALENDAR_ID: id from the calendar booking link
GHL_FIELD_REF: custom field id of GE Ref
GHL_FIELD_SOURCE: custom field id of GE Source
GHL_FIELD_RESCHEDULE: custom field id of GE Reschedule Link
GHL_FIELD_CANCEL: custom field id of GE Cancel Link
